description.narrative: MCC's Board voted to terminate this program in August 2025. Togo Threshold - INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS project: The objectives of this project are to improve access to high-quality, reasonably-priced ICT services in Togo through: (1) increased competition among ICT service providers in the sector, (2) effective and independent regulation, (3) targeted investments and incentives, where necessary, to increase service in otherwise unprofitable areas, and (4) support for greater ICT utilization.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.

No event or series of events, circumstance or condition has occurred since the date this Agreement was signed, or currently exists, which in MCC�s reasonable opinion, has adversely affected or could adversely affect the achievement of the ICT Project Objective before the Completion Date.
